image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a bison standing in a grassy field. The image captures the head, prominent shoulder hump, and forequarters in detail. The fur is thick, shaggy, and dark brown, particularly around the head and shoulders. One horn is clearly visible, curved and light-colored at the tip. The background shows blurred vegetation and hints of another bison's back in the upper left.
